question: For each subdomain, list which regulations cover it and how many clauses each contributes
cypher: MATCH (r:Regulation)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(c:Clause)-[:MAPPED_TO]->(sd:SubDomain) WITH sd.subDomainId AS subDomainId, sd.name AS subDomainName, collect({ regulationId: r.regulationId, clauseCount: count(c), totalNormativeIntensity: sum(c.normativeIntensity) }) AS regulationsData UNWIND regulationsData AS regData WITH sd.subDomainId AS subDomainId, sd.name AS subDomainName, regData.regulationId AS regulationId, regData.clauseCount AS clauseCount, regData.totalNormativeIntensity AS totalNormativeIntensity RETURN sd.subDomainId, sd.name, regulationId, clauseCount, totalNormativeIntensity ORDER BY sd.subDomainId, regulationId;
